card.name: Names and sizes of named study cohorts
card.fires_on: Words inside descriptions of named research cohorts or studies, such as the cohort's name, "the" before it, or the sample-size number. Seen in epidemiology summaries of large population studies.

modes.label: Cohort names

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that describe studies, like "prospective" and "Benchmark", and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It lights up when a news-style text introduces a large named study group and how many people were in it.
